description: Precision control: lines that open with a dash, an angle or a symbol without being items of a list. Nothing is likely. Held back as info, each with its reason: a dialogue with en dashes in paragraphs and one with hyphens on lines separated by br (weakSentences), a quoted reply (quotePrefix), two alerts with a warning sign (fewSymbolItems), links that open with an arrow (itemsAreControls, and fewSymbolItems for two), clickable accordion titles with a triangle (itemsAreControls), a legend with a square in a different colour before each entry (colouredMarkers), German dates (sameWordAfterNumber), authors with initials (initialsAndNames). Not reported for their bullets at all: star ratings, temperatures below zero. Not reported as names and values: a chat whose names repeat, a feed of activity whose keys are in two styles.
